parameters.query:
INSERT INTO agent_decisions (
  conversation_id,
  estado_entrada,
  mensaje_usuario,
  intent,
  sentiment,
  confidence,
  next_state,
  trigger_handoff,
  trigger_loss,
  response_text,
  full_response,
  latencia_ms,
  model_used,
  is_fallback
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.body.conversation_id }}'::uuid,
  '{{ $json.body.estado_entrada }}',
  '{{ $json.body.mensaje_usuario }}',
  '{{ $json.body.intent }}',
  '{{ $json.body.sentiment }}',
  {{ $json.body.confidence || 0 }},
  '{{ $json.body.next_state }}',
  {{ $json.body.trigger_handoff || false }},
  {{ $json.body.trigger_loss || false }},
  '{{ $json.body.response_text }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.body.full_response || {}) }}'::jsonb,
  {{ $json.body.latencia_ms || 0 }},
  '{{ $json.body.model_used || "gpt-4.1-mini" }}',
  {{ $json.body.is_fallback || false }}
)
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
